theorem lg_target {Ω : Type u_1} {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} {X : Ω → ℝ} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {t : ℝ} (ht_int_pos : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)) μ) (ht_int_neg : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (-t * X ω)) μ) : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (|t| * |X ω|)) μ := by
  have h_exp_bound : ∀ᵐ[μ], Real.exp (|t| * |X ω|) ≤ Real.exp (t * X ω) + Real.exp (-t * X ω) :=
    by
      intro ω
      rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_neg]
      exact Real.exp_pos _
      exact Real.exp_pos _
      have h1 : t * X ω ≤ |t| * |X ω| := Real.mul_le_abs_mul t (X ω)
      have h2 : -t * X ω ≤ |t| * |X ω| := Real.mul_le_abs_mul (-t) (X ω)
      exact Real.exp_le_exp h1.trans (Real.abs_nonneg _).le
      exact Real.exp_le_exp h2.trans (Real.abs_nonneg _).le

  have h_int_bound : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω) + Real.exp (-t * X ω)) μ :=
    by
      rw [MeasureTheory.Integrable.add]
      exact ht_int_pos
      exact ht_int_neg

  apply MeasureTheory.Integrable.le_of_integrable
  exact h_exp_bound
  exact h_int_bound
